verdict.rationale: The evidence shows configurable sync modes, incremental syncs that pull only changed data, and manual sync triggers. These are adjacent to backfill and resync control, but no cited doc says a single table or stream can be reset or refreshed independently. One hands-on user also had to write custom code and 'trick' Airbyte to backfill a large 8-billion-row table, which points to real backfill limitations. Missing for 10: documented per-stream/per-table resync or refresh, a documented historical backfill workflow, and independent confirmation that resyncs work without rebuilding the connection.
